Run the water balance model

Source: R/wbm.R
wbm_run.Rd

Run the water balance model

Usage

wbm_run(
  forcing,
  params,
  pet_method = c("oudin", "hamon", "penman_monteith", "gridmet"),
  ros = FALSE,
  init = list(snowpack = 0, soil = 0, storage = 0)
)

Arguments

forcing

Daily tibble with date, prcp_mm, tmean_c; plus tmin_c, tmax_c, srad_wm2, rhmin_pct, rhmax_pct, wind_ms for Penman-Monteith, or pet_ref_mm for pet_method = "gridmet". Must be gap-free.

params

Named list or one-row data frame: site parameters plus any of wbm_default_params() to override.

pet_method

"oudin", "hamon", "penman_monteith" (FAO-56 grass reference ET computed from the forcing), or "gridmet" (GridMET's precomputed ASCE grass reference ET). The two reference-ET methods require kc_dormant and kc_growing in params.

ros

If TRUE, add rain-on-snow melt enhancement (hock + 0.0125 x rain).

init

list(snowpack, soil, storage) initial states in mm.

Value

Tibble of daily fluxes and states (mm): rain, snow, melt, snowpack, pet_ref (ETo or the raw Oudin/Hamon PET), kc, pet, aet, soil, excess, storage, direct, runoff, deficit.
